description:
One match-region step list for every consumer.

Today (compiler.md C3, C4, C5, C15; runtime.md R8, R16):
- Binary matching has 5 walkers: native dispatch, interp dispatch, receive, native body re-read, interp body re-read.
- Construction has 2 copies.
- Tag, default-unit and endian tables are copied about 5 times.
- BitstringFieldKind/BitstringEndian duplicate ast::BitType/ast::Endian.
- Literal-to-integer-field expansion exists twice: pattern.rs:1198 via ast binary_literal_fields, and quoted_function.rs:1625 literal_as_integer_fields. ConstBitstring is emitted in two places (native.rs:3270, :6087).
- Receive lowers binary patterns with one extern per field, while function clauses are inline.
- bit_len and base are re-derived per clause and again in the body, and sibling literal clauses share no prefix test.

Fix:
- One field description (ast::BitType/Endian).
- One step list per pattern, built once, consumed by native dispatch, the native body, receive and the interpreter.
- Receive uses the inline lowering.
- Sibling clauses share a prefix test.
- One expansion; one ConstBitstring emitter.

Folds the remaining fz-sc8.183 work: .4 and .9 are the same seam, "a match reads its subject once with one bounds implementation". Re-baseline the sc8.183 epic into this.

Asm first: targets for a 3-clause literal dispatch (shared prefix) and a receive on a literal.

Acceptance:
- Walker count from 5 to 1 producer.
- The receive listing has no per-field extern.
- Three-path fixtures unchanged; no pin rises.

comments.text: User approved in JSON's session, verbatim "yes" (relayed by JSON, 2026-11-19). Source: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-json-four-proposals.html, item P4, folded here. Each added function clause costs 17 more transport_shape requests (1/2/4/8/16 clauses: 555/572/606/674/810; every added request is transport_shape). Causes: lower_bitstring_pattern (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs ~3787-3830) emits push_const(0) plus a read for every field, including literal, ignored and omitted-rest fields the dispatch plan already tests; lower_clause (body.rs ~1281-1305) gives each clause fresh parameter ValueIds instead of aliasing the plan's shared subjects. Fix: emit only the reads the body uses; alias parameters to the subjects. Predictions (unmeasured): constant-return clause 5 -> ~1, call clause 8 -> ~6, append-plus-call 17 -> ~13. Numbers predate recent develop: re-measure first. Acceptance: the N-clause reproducer's per-clause slope falls, the distiller drive pin falls, three paths agree.

From #864 (fz-mue.23): an expression segment size is BitstringFieldSize::Guard, evaluated at three sites the fold must cover: read_bitstring/bit_size_value (interp, src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs), lower_bitstring_region/lower_dispatch_bit_size (native dispatch, src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs), emit_bitstring_test/emit_dispatch_bit_size (receive, src/compiler2/native_codegen/receive.rs).
